raw_response:

2. The chart shows “Common” at 14.9% and “Person” at 30.5%, so “Common” is about half of “Person.” The premise that “Common” is 20% is not supported by the figure.

3. The sample size is not provided in the chart, so its effect on reliability cannot be assessed from the figure alone. Generally, larger sample sizes make percentage estimates more reliable.
